blocks.text: The Majhail Sikhs propose a hard strategy: they will remain as a fighting rear guard while the Guru moves on, because without battle none of them expects either escape or honor. (6–8)
During the night the groups split and scatter, some carrying news, some searching routes, some lingering near the Guru, but the martial intention of the Majhail band remains fixed. (9–12)
This page makes Majhail resolve central to the coming battle, showing how local initiative and willingness for sacrifice begin to shape the field before the clash itself. (13–14)
